_doc: Per-vertical rigor record + living scorecard. Backfilled 2026-05-29 from the four-lens audit. `ceiling` is the strongest claim word a doc in this vertical may use without an explicit override; it is set conservatively from the apparatus actually present. Update `ceiling` only when a higher-tier apparatus is genuinely added (e.g. a held-out cohort routes through the published numbers).

public_co.notes: Catastrophe-recall reaches 'predictive' via walk-forward realized outcomes (Tier 3, 85% recall). Basket-ALPHA does NOT: empirically not durable (Tier 2/3). So 'alpha'/'predictive' achievement claims in public_co docs should still trip the enforced check and get human review; ceiling held at 'validated' deliberately.

muni_credit.notes: A genuine blind out-of-sample apparatus exists in standalone blind_oos_* scripts and could earn 'validated'. But the five published outputs/*FINDINGS.md rest on concurrent / in-sample validation (BACKTEST self-flags in-sample outcome-curation bias). Ceiling kept at 'discriminated' until the published numbers route through the blind-OOS path.

buyside_dd.notes: Single-deal forensic mode by design; held-out cohort is not applicable. Divergences were flagged; neither deal has a confirmed fraud outcome. 'Validated' is the wrong word for this evidence tier.

property_tax.notes: Large raw N but the cross-source corroboration is void: mls_sales is 285489/285490 repackaged assessor records, so method_agreement=both is self-referential. fraud_score weights fit to the canonical LASALLE case; no non-LASALLE holdout; score is explicitly NOT a falsifiable probability.

carbon_offsets.notes: Satellite-vs-claim divergence; the only quasi-control is a symmetric pass-list (10 PASS) showing it isn't a one-way flag generator. No null/random baseline, no realized outcome. The docs themselves say this is not a finding any project is fraudulent.

rent_stabilization.notes: Own methodology_audit concedes no scored cohort, no held-out cohort, no ranking against an outcome-known HCR enforcement list.

art_donation_fraud.notes: Cohort runner shipped; no stated N, no control, no validated outcomes; recapture rule implementation is None.
